summary.zh-CN: Transformer Block 通常由[[term:multi-head-attention|多头注意力]]和[[term:position-wise-ffn|逐位置前馈网络]]两个核心子层组成，并在每个子层周围使用[[term:residual-connection|残差连接]]与 [[term:layer-normalization|LayerNorm]]。注意力负责位置间的信息交换，前馈网络负责每个位置内部的非线性加工。
summary.en-US: A Transformer Block usually contains two core sublayers: [[term:multi-head-attention|multi-head attention]] and a [[term:position-wise-ffn|position-wise feed-forward network]]. Each sublayer is surrounded by [[term:residual-connection|residual connections]] and [[term:layer-normalization|LayerNorm]]. Attention exchanges information across positions; the feed-forward network performs nonlinear processing within each position.

coreConclusion.zh-CN: 一个 Block 先让不同位置交换信息，再让每个位置独立加工自己的特征，并用残差与归一化支持深层堆叠。
coreConclusion.en-US: A Block first lets positions exchange information, then lets each position process its own features independently, with residual connections and normalization supporting deep stacks.
